hotels.title: Tasmania Luxury Suites on Macquarie Harbour with Daily Dining Credit & Nightly Cocktails
hotels.description: Nestled in Strahan on the edge of Tasmania's UNESCO Wilderness World Heritage Area, Risby Cove is a boutique retreat where Macquarie Harbour stretches to the horizon and the West Coast's wild beauty is impossible to ignore. Newly reopened after a transformative multi-million-dollar renovation, the twelve bespoke suites face either the harbour or the rainforest, each with a private deck or courtyard. When dinner calls, Risby's restaurant is one of the finest reasons to visit Strahan in its own right. The seasonal menu draws on ethically raised meats, organic vegetables and the freshest local seafood, paired with Tasmanian wines, gins and spirits and served against the quiet reflection of the harbour after dark. Beyond the property, the West Coast rewards the curious - and with kayaks and e-bikes included in your stay, it's yours to explore. The Gordon River, Ocean Beach and the vast expanse of Macquarie Harbour are all on your doorstep, in a part of the world where the wild is still genuinely wild.
